newsitem.title: USA: Cali Realty buys N.Y. property for $8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Cali Realty buys N.Y. property for $8 mln.

text.p: Cali Realty Corp said Monday it bought a 84,000 square-foot office building in Yonkers, N.Y., for $8 million in cash.
The real estate investment trust said it bought the building through exercising a buy option obtained when it bought Robert Martin Co earlier this year for $440 million.

Cali said the building, which is part of the South Westchester Executive Park complex, is currently 98 percent leased. The acquisition increases Cali's holdings in Westchester county to 63 properties with a total of four million square feet.
